title: Generative Predictive Control: Flow Matching Policies for Dynamic, Difficult-to-Demonstrate Tasks

sources.title: Generative Predictive Control: Flow Matching Policies for Dynamic, Difficult-to-Demonstrate Tasks
sources.review_notes: All 10 pages reviewed against page renders by one reviewer agent (reports/review-pages-0001-0010.md): equations (1a)-(35), Proposition 1 with its proof and Remark 1 transcribed to LaTeX from the authors' TeX and compared with 220 dpi crops; Figures 1, 2, 3(a), 3(b), 4, 5 checked on all four edges; Algorithm 1 kept as a crop with a line-numbered transcription; Tables I-III checked cell by cell; references [1]-[46] all read against 200 dpi crops. Verifier diagnostics on pages 2-10 are LaTeX-notation, minus-glyph, algorithm-transcription, glued table cells (second parser) and '10^-3' differences, adjudicated per page.

navigation.heading: I. INTRODUCTION AND RELATED WORK

navigation.heading: II. BACKGROUND

navigation.heading: B. Generative Modeling
